_comment: Read-side registry for notion-ingest-agent (.claude/agents/notion-ingest-agent.md). All Notion ids, property names, windows, and thresholds live here so a renamed property or a new source is a one-line data edit, never a code change. Write-side counterpart: notion-destinations.json. Source: Albert's live Notion workspace, verified via Notion MCP 2026-07-28.
_maintenance: Notion property/status strings are EXACT MATCH. If someone renames a property or status option in Notion, this file goes stale silently — queries start erroring or returning empty. Re-verify against the live schema (notion-fetch on the data_source url) whenever a query starts failing on an unknown column.

titan_projects._comment: Every row is a won project — Date Won is a created_time property (row creation IS the win event, downstream of GHL '2. *Project Won* '). No numeric Status field exists. Date Won is a PLAIN column in SQL, not date:X:start (400s if queried that way).

qa_work_orders._comment: Covers deficiencies AND warranty calls via QA Type (Deficiency / Warranty / Other). Date Created and Completed Date are real date properties -> use date:X:start virtual columns.

master_payments_log._comment: The only payments database — there is no separate 'Notion payments'. Amount is CAD float -> convert to integer cents.

tactical_tasks_list._comment: Same database notion-sync WRITES to (see notion-destinations.json 'team'). This agent only READS it for staleness. Two url concepts: the row's own page url (identity key) vs the 'url' PROPERTY (userDefined:url — set only on notion-sync-created rows; used to exclude today's sync writes, cross-checked against actions-log.json).

project_status_meetings._comment: Weekly cadence. Titles are NOT reliably date-suffixed (older rows are plain 'Project Status') — identify by page url only. Meeting Summary property links to the meeting-processor skill's output page (the cheap deep-read path). Each meeting page body holds inline child databases — enumerated dynamically on deep pull, never hardcoded by name.

v2_candidates._comment: Captured ids for sources NOT in v1 scope. Flip cii_enabled and add a type to the agent file to activate CII.
